body.description: Create one pixel-art tactical dungeon scene in the exact visual language of the supplied CHARACTER SHEET: chunky dark charcoal outlines, compact large-headed tiny fantasy figures, restrained sage/olive greens, dusty mauve/violet, blue steel and copper accents, simple 2-3 tone pixel clusters. Reinterpret these character designs into volume; do not copy the sheet layout or white backdrop. SAME ELEVATED ISOMETRIC CAMERA for FLOOR AND ALL CHARACTERS. Symmetric diamond tile TOPS width:height 4:3 (like 128x96), NOT flat 2:1. Oblique shoulders, visible top of heads/helmets and side of torsos/shields, bodies facing diagonal grid axes; NO flat front-facing sprites. Six small figures, separated, each occupies ONE clearly bounded tile. Both soles directly touch the middle of that tile, feet wholly inside its edges, never straddling seams. Leave ample visible floor around feet; no hidden foot positions behind props. NO pedestals, discs, plinths, little personal platforms, rings or selection markers. Only tiny contact shadows. Continuous floor, simple matching environment, crisp stepped pixels, no smooth painting, no blur, no text, no UI. Show entire room with dark neutral margin. Landscape 4:3 canvas. SCENE: Asymmetric rectangular forge with a squat cold furnace rear left, anvil at rear right, narrow wood stack along a wall; spacious central tile grid. Six figures: bronze axeman, blue wizard, green rogue, armored goblin, skeleton and red imp. CORRECTION TO FIRST RESULT: Preserve forge layout and approximate figure locations, but TURN the left axeman, central skeleton and all other character HEADS, TORSOS, SHOULDERS and BOOTS visibly 45 degrees toward diagonal grid axes. Show substantial top-of-head/helmet and side-of-torso planes; never a flat front-facing sprite. Place both soles of each figure inside one full distinct 4:3 diamond floor cell, with no personal base or pedestal.

style_image.usage_description: Character sheet is STYLE and character design reference only. Reinterpret each character in true elevated isometric view, with visible top and side surfaces. Do not copy white background or frontal sprites.

reference_images.usage_description: Use the exact symmetric 4:3 diamond TILE TOP geometry; characters stand with both feet centered on a single tile, without pedestal or selection disk.
Use this continuous 4:3 isometric board projection and common elevated camera for both room and characters. Ignore annotations, isolated example tiles, grass colors and UI lettering.
FIRST GENERATED SCENE is a layout and color reference ONLY. Preserve recognizable room composition. Apply all correction instructions to characters or bridge; do not repeat the first result flaws.
